_why: Main's protection (TF-077 AC1, ADR-0055), applied with make protect-main and checked with make protection-check. A change reaches main only through a pull request, up to date with main, whose every check below is green; nobody, administrators included, pushes to main, forces it or deletes it. No approving review is required while the team has one developer: the process exception PE-1 in docs/security/exceptions.md, which ends by setting required_approving_review_count to 1. Each check is the name of a CI job, made by GitHub Actions (app 15368), so no other integration can report it. Keys that start with an underscore are notes, not sent.
